summary: One observable outcome: the critical path is physically and numerically balance-correct, verified by the section 32 validators (simulateCriticalPath + full validateWorld) and headless route scenarios, with §40 scarcity materials placed per the 130-170% / ≥2-node rule. The four deliverables (build validator, extend validateWorld, write route scenarios, tune placement) are parts of one coherent verification-and-adjustment behavior, not independently shippable features. Subsystems: headless scenario tests (validator source + route scenarios + scarcity walk, all headless) and balance tuning (worldData material placement); the validator is headless validation infrastructure, not a separate subsystem. Two subsystems, within the leaf limit. AC-bal-scarcity is carried verbatim from ST-07; WI-07b is the sole owner and named final proof owner. depends_on is empty, correctly inheriting ST-06 from the parent. The handoff names every file and function a fresh implementer needs; the one open assumption (whether 'first relevant area' is expressed in data) is explicitly flagged with a fallback. No pacing, oxygen, or frame-rate scope bleeds in (those are WI-07c/WI-07d). Evidence is focused: each test group maps to a specific checkable assertion, and the broken-fixture tests prove the validators are live. No findings requiring split or revise.
